svg.title: Level 2 overlay - Rail Service
svg.desc: Rail Service layer based on official ProRail Spoorwegen trace geometry, aligned to the Level 1 Netherlands SVG.
svg.metadata: Source: PDOK / ProRail Spoorwegen OGC API, collection trace, CC0 1.0. Coordinates transformed from CRS84 lon/lat to this deck's 1600x900 Level 1 SVG viewBox.
